description:
Problem: core can now build a bundle for a given commit (site-inputs.yml dispatch with core_sha), so one release commit can have several certified bundles. v0.5.0 (commit dfe585e) has two: site-inputs run 42114319044 (2026-11-05, the one pinned) and run 43498628032 (2026-11-13). Pinning from the second changed release-pin/manifest.json: parent_source, produced_at and three member digests differ. `npm run docs:pin -- <tag>` fetches through bundle-fetch with SITE_INPUTS_CORE_SHA, which takes the first unexpired develop artifact of that name, so which production is pinned depends on listing order, and re-running the pin can change the published docs inputs without any core change.

Outcome: the pin is reproducible, and it is known whether two productions of the same commit can differ in docs-data, doc-contracts.json or repo-files.json, which would mean the exporters are not deterministic or depend on the parent.
